posts.title: A lease with a timeout is not a lock
posts.description: Four fixes for one duplicate email. Each one closed a real gap. None of them was a lock, because none of them ran inside the write.

posts.title: Durable Objects without Cloudflare, on the database you already run
posts.description: The Durable Objects programming model as a plain library on the SQL database you already run. And as of this week, the whole runtime runs in a browser tab on SQLite WASM.
